source: Held-out prompts for the second acceptance (iteration 2), written blind by a new session given only the five task-family names; kept outside the repository and never copied into it. The harness reads them at run time (--sets heldout-v2) and refuses the file when its SHA-256 differs from evals/heldout-v2.sha256. Case ids carry a v2 suffix so their rows never collide with the first set's.
families: The same five task families as the first set (SPEC section 13): four create requests, the first with the money gate before any generation, and a download-and-transcribe request that should not load the skill. The expected routes below follow those families.
reply: Anything I haven't said is your call. Go ahead and plan it here.
